top_violation_types.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Bottles in the toddler's room were not labeled with children's names.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Only two caregivers (including the director) were present during the inspection. A thrid caregiver was needed to maintain ratio during naptime.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregiver was observed to not wash the infant's hands before eating.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver was observed in direct care of 11 children with three of those children being ages 0-17 months of age; the maximum number of children to be   supervised by one caregiver was 7, therefore the caregiver was over by 4 children.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.
